fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must expire at least 6 months after arrival and have at least one blank page.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe vencer al menos 6 meses después de la llegada y tener al menos una página en blanco.
entry.quote: at least 6 months after the date you arrive and at least one blank page

entry.en: You must be ready to show a return or onward ticket at border control.
entry.es: Debes estar listo para mostrar un boleto de regreso o de continuación en el control fronterizo.
entry.quote: You must be ready to show your return or onward ticket at border control.

entry.en: All visitors except residents must have the mandatory Tanzanian Government inbound travel insurance, even with a personal policy.
entry.es: Todos los visitantes, salvo los residentes, deben tener el seguro de viaje obligatorio del gobierno de Tanzania, incluso si ya tienen una póliza personal.
entry.quote: All visitors to mainland Tanzania and Zanzibar, except residents, must have mandatory Tanzanian Government-provided inbound travel insurance, even if they already have a personal policy in place.

entry.en: You need a yellow fever vaccination certificate if you are coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Necesitas un certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si vienes de un país catalogado como de riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk

entry.en: Border officials have arrested foreigners for trying to take wildlife items, including horns and seashells, out of the country.
entry.es: Los funcionarios fronterizos han arrestado a extranjeros por intentar sacar del país artículos de fauna, incluidos cuernos y conchas marinas.
entry.quote: Border officials have arrested foreigners for trying to take wildlife items, including horns and seashells, out of the country.

entry.en: If you arrive by air you will be asked to hand over all plastic bags on arrival.
entry.es: Si llegas en avión se te pedirá que entregues todas las bolsas de plástico al llegar.
entry.quote: If you arrive by air you’ll be asked to hand over all plastic bags on arrival.

safety.en: FCDO advises against all but essential travel within 20km of the border with Mozambique's Cabo Delgado province because of attacks by groups linked with Islamic extremism.
safety.es: El FCDO desaconseja todo viaje no esencial a menos de 20 km de la frontera con la provincia mozambiqueña de Cabo Delgado por ataques de grupos vinculados al extremismo islámico.
safety.quote: FCDO advises against all but essential travel to any area within 20km of the Tanzanian border with the Cabo Delgado province of Mozambique, due to attacks by groups linked with Islamic extremism.

safety.en: Terrorist attacks in Tanzania cannot be ruled out.
safety.es: No se pueden descartar atentados terroristas en Tanzania.
safety.quote: Terrorist attacks in Tanzania cannot be ruled out.

safety.en: Stay away from all demonstrations, rallies and large crowds, and follow social and local media for updates.
safety.es: Mantente alejado de manifestaciones, mítines y multitudes, y sigue las redes sociales y los medios locales para informarte.
safety.quote: Stay away from all demonstrations, rallies and large crowds, and monitor social media and local media for up-to-date information.

safety.en: There is a risk of armed crime, including armed robbery, throughout Tanzania.
safety.es: Hay riesgo de delitos armados, incluido el robo a mano armada, en toda Tanzania.
safety.quote: There is a risk of armed crime, including armed robbery, throughout Tanzania.

safety.en: In Dar es Salaam, tourists have been 'express kidnapped': assaulted, robbed and forced under threat of violence to withdraw cash from ATMs.
safety.es: En Dar es Salaam han ocurrido secuestros exprés de turistas: los agreden, los roban y los obligan con amenazas a retirar efectivo de cajeros.
safety.quote: In Dar es Salaam, tourists have been ‘express kidnapped’. This means they’ve been assaulted, robbed and forced with the threat of violence to withdraw cash from ATMs.

safety.en: Same-sex sexual activity is illegal in Tanzania, including Zanzibar.
safety.es: La actividad sexual entre personas del mismo sexo es ilegal en Tanzania, incluido Zanzíbar.
safety.quote: Same-sex sexual activity is illegal in Tanzania, including Zanzibar.

health.en: Medical facilities are limited, especially outside Dar es Salaam.
health.es: Las instalaciones médicas son limitadas, especialmente fuera de Dar es Salaam.
health.quote: Medical facilities are limited, especially outside Dar es Salaam.

health.en: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Tanzania.
health.es: El mal de altura es un riesgo en algunas partes de Tanzania.
health.quote: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Tanzania.

health.en: Malaria is transmitted by mosquitoes and is endemic to Tanzania.
health.es: La malaria se transmite por mosquitos y es endémica en Tanzania.
health.quote: Malaria is transmitted by mosquitoes and is endemic to Tanzania.

health.en: The text says not to drink tap water unless there is no other option, and then only filtered with a high quality filter and purifier or boiled.
health.es: El texto indica no beber agua del grifo salvo que no haya otra opción, y solo filtrada con un buen filtro y purificador o hervida.
health.quote: You shouldn't drink the tap water unless you have no other option, and it must either be filtered with a high quality filter and purifier or brought to a boil before consumption.

health.en: Cholera is more or less seasonal in Zanzibar, where outbreaks frequently occur during the rainy seasons.
health.es: El cólera es más o menos estacional en Zanzíbar, donde los brotes ocurren con frecuencia en las temporadas de lluvia.
health.quote: Cholera is more or less a seasonal phenomenon in Zanzibar, where outbreaks frequently occur during the rainy seasons.

help.en: The emergency number in Tanzania is 112 for ambulance, fire and police.
help.es: El número de emergencias en Tanzania es el 112 para ambulancia, bomberos y policía.

help.en: The text suggests that, if you can, it is probably better to go straight to the nearest police station instead of dialing 112.
help.es: El texto sugiere que, si puedes, probablemente sea mejor ir directamente a la comisaría más cercana en lugar de marcar el 112.
help.quote: If you can, it's probably better to go straight to the nearest police station, instead of dialing 112.

getting_in.en: One of the two major airports is Julius Nyerere International Airport (DAR) in Dar es Salaam.
getting_in.es: Uno de los dos aeropuertos principales es el Aeropuerto Internacional Julius Nyerere (DAR) en Dar es Salaam.
getting_in.quote: one in Dar es Salaam, Julius Nyerere International Airport (DAR IATA)

getting_in.en: The other major airport is Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO), halfway between Arusha and Moshi.
getting_in.es: El otro aeropuerto principal es el Aeropuerto Internacional del Kilimanjaro (JRO), a medio camino entre Arusha y Moshi.
getting_in.quote: and one in Kilimanjaro, Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO IATA), which is halfway between Arusha and Moshi

getting_in.en: At the Namanga crossing, scammers in no man's land offer poor exchange rates and pretend to be officials selling Tanzania visa stamps.
getting_in.es: En el cruce de Namanga, estafadores en tierra de nadie ofrecen tipos de cambio muy malos y fingen ser funcionarios que venden sellos de visa de Tanzania.
getting_in.quote: Scammers in the no man's land between the border control offices of Kenya and Tanzania will try several scams, including offering outrageously poor currency exchange rates and pretending to be officials selling Tanzania visa stamps.

getting_in.en: At land borders the visa fee is paid in cash, and it is a good idea to have the exact amount in US dollars.
getting_in.es: En las fronteras terrestres la tarifa de visa se paga en efectivo, y conviene tener el monto exacto en dólares estadounidenses.
getting_in.quote: At land borders, the visa fee is to be paid in cash. It is a good idea to have the exact amount of US$ at hand!

getting_in.en: The TAZARA train runs twice a week between New Kapiri Mposhi, Zambia, and Dar es Salaam, leaving Dar es Salaam on Tuesdays and Fridays.
getting_in.es: El tren TAZARA circula dos veces por semana entre New Kapiri Mposhi, Zambia, y Dar es Salaam, saliendo de Dar es Salaam los martes y viernes.
getting_in.quote: The Tanzania - Zambia train service, known as TAZARA, operates trains twice a week between New Kapiri Mposhi, Zambia, and Dar es Salaam, leaving from Dar es Salaam on Tuesdays and Fridays.

getting_around.en: The bus is the most common way to travel around Tanzania.
getting_around.es: El autobús es la forma más común de desplazarse por Tanzania.
getting_around.quote: The bus is the most common way to travel around in Tanzania.

getting_around.en: In Dar es Salaam, minibuses called Dala-Dalas go cheaply to most places in the city.
getting_around.es: En Dar es Salaam, los minibuses llamados Dala-Dalas llegan de forma económica a la mayoría de lugares de la ciudad.
getting_around.quote: In Dar, minibuses called Dala-Dalas can be taken cheaply to most places within the city.

getting_around.en: Three-wheeled tuktuks are cheaper than a taxi and can get past traffic jams, but are probably not the safest option.
getting_around.es: Los tuk-tuks de tres ruedas son más baratos que un taxi y esquivan los atascos, pero probablemente no son la opción más segura.
getting_around.quote: There are also three-wheeled tuktuks/baby taxis/CNGs/bajajis that zoom around. They are cheaper than a taxi, and can get past traffic jams. It's probably not the safest option.

getting_around.en: Private taxis are a convenient choice, but you should negotiate the price before using them.
getting_around.es: Los taxis privados son una opción cómoda, pero hay que negociar el precio antes de usarlos.
getting_around.quote: Private taxis are also a convenient choice, but be sure to negotiate the price before you use them.

getting_around.en: Traffic in Tanzania drives on the left.
getting_around.es: En Tanzania se conduce por la izquierda.
getting_around.quote: Tanzanians drive on the left (like in the UK, India, Australia, Japan, and other countries)

getting_around.en: Road accidents claim more lives in Tanzania than any other cause of death.
getting_around.es: Los accidentes de tráfico causan en Tanzania más muertes que cualquier otra causa.
getting_around.quote: Road accidents claim more lives in Tanzania than any other cause of death.

money.en: The currency of Tanzania is the Tanzanian shilling (TSh, ISO code TZS).
money.es: La moneda de Tanzania es el chelín tanzano (TSh, código ISO TZS).
money.quote: The currency of Tanzania is known as the Tanzanian shilling, denoted by the symbol "TSh" or by "/=" or "/-" following the number (ISO code:TZS).

money.en: Most shops expect shillings, while visas, safaris and Kilimanjaro treks are generally priced in US dollars and non-residents pay national park fees in US dollars.
money.es: La mayoría de tiendas esperan chelines, mientras que visas, safaris y treks al Kilimanjaro suelen cotizarse en dólares y los no residentes pagan las entradas a parques en dólares.
money.quote: Most stores and restaurants expect payment in Tanzanian shillings. On the other hand, travel visas, safaris and Kilimanjaro treks are generally priced in US dollars, and entry fees to national parks must be paid in US dollars by non-residents.

money.en: Older US$100 notes are no longer accepted, and any note older than 2003 will most likely be refused everywhere.
money.es: Los billetes antiguos de 100 dólares ya no se aceptan, y cualquier billete anterior a 2003 probablemente será rechazado en todas partes.
money.quote: Older US$100 notes are no longer accepted in Tanzania, and any note older than 2003 will most likely be refused everywhere.

money.en: Traveller's cheques have become impossible to cash.
money.es: Los cheques de viajero se han vuelto imposibles de cambiar.
money.quote: Traveller's cheques have become impossible to cash in.

money.en: ATMs are mostly located in the city centre and on the Msasani Peninsula.
money.es: Los cajeros automáticos están sobre todo en el centro de la ciudad y en la península de Msasani.
money.quote: ATMs are mostly located in the city centre and on the Msasani Peninsula.

money.en: Credit cards can be used in big supermarkets, malls, large hotels, resorts and with certain travel agents, and to get cash from ATMs.
money.es: Las tarjetas de crédito se pueden usar en grandes supermercados, centros comerciales, hoteles grandes, resorts y algunas agencias de viaje, y para sacar efectivo.
money.quote: Credit cards can be used in big supermarkets, malls, large hotels, resorts and with certain travel agents – and to get cash from ATMs.

etiquette.en: Tourists should wear modest or conservative attire, especially in Zanzibar, a conservative Muslim society.
etiquette.es: Los turistas deben vestir de forma modesta o conservadora, sobre todo en Zanzíbar, una sociedad musulmana conservadora.
etiquette.quote: In general, tourists should wear modest or conservative attire, especially in Zanzibar, which is a conservative Muslim society.

etiquette.en: Western women should not wear clothing that reveals too much skin.
etiquette.es: Las mujeres occidentales no deben usar ropa que muestre demasiada piel.
etiquette.quote: Western women should not wear clothing that reveals too much skin.

etiquette.en: Masai people expect to be paid for photos, and you should always ask before taking pictures.
etiquette.es: Los masáis esperan que se les pague por las fotos, y siempre se debe pedir permiso antes de tomar fotografías.
etiquette.quote: However, they expect to be paid for it, and you should always ask before taking pictures.

etiquette.en: Swahili speakers commonly say 'shikamoo' when greeting elders or superiors.
etiquette.es: Los hablantes de suajili suelen decir 'shikamoo' al saludar a mayores o superiores.
etiquette.quote: It is common practice among Swahili-speakers to use 'shikamoo' (pronounced 'she ka moe' and literally meaning, 'I hold your feet') when greeting elders or superiors.

etiquette.en: The text says Tanzanians find the word "hapana" (no) quite rude, so it should be used only as a last resort.
etiquette.es: El texto dice que a los tanzanos la palabra "hapana" (no) les resulta bastante grosera, por lo que solo debe usarse como último recurso.
etiquette.quote: Tanzanians find the word "hapana" quite rude, so please don't use it casually -- only as a last resort.

etiquette.en: During Ramadan, avoid eating or drinking in public, outside of hotels or restaurants.
etiquette.es: Durante el Ramadán, evita comer o beber en público, fuera de hoteles o restaurantes.
etiquette.quote: Ramadan is a holy month for Muslims. The dates vary by year and country. During this time, avoid eating or drinking in public, outside of hotels or restaurants.

connectivity.en: Staying in touch is rarely a problem in Tanzania, with decent mobile reception even in some national parks.
connectivity.es: Mantenerse comunicado rara vez es un problema en Tanzania, con cobertura móvil aceptable incluso en algunos parques nacionales.
connectivity.quote: Keeping in touch while traveling in Tanzania is rarely a problem. You can get decent mobile phone reception even in some national parks.

connectivity.en: With an unlocked phone you can buy a local SIM card for 500 Tsh; the most popular providers are Airtel, Vodacom and Tigo.
connectivity.es: Con un teléfono desbloqueado puedes comprar una SIM local por 500 Tsh; los proveedores más populares son Airtel, Vodacom y Tigo.
connectivity.quote: you can purchase a local SIM card for 500 Tsh from a series of Tanzanian service providers. The most popular are Airtel, Vodacom, and Tigo.

connectivity.en: 4G coverage is available in many areas of Dar es Salaam, Arusha, Zanzibar town and other cities.
connectivity.es: Hay cobertura 4G en muchas zonas de Dar es Salaam, Arusha, la ciudad de Zanzíbar y otras ciudades.
connectivity.quote: 4G coverage is available in many areas of Dar es Salaam, Arusha, Zanzibar town and other cities in the country.

connectivity.en: An 8GB/month data bundle costs around Tsh10,000, SIM card included.
connectivity.es: Un paquete de datos de 8 GB al mes cuesta unos Tsh10.000, con la SIM incluida.
connectivity.quote: An 8GB/month data bundle costs around Tsh10,000, SIM card included.

connectivity.en: Authorities have previously limited internet access during or after protests.
connectivity.es: Las autoridades han limitado antes el acceso a internet durante o después de protestas.
connectivity.quote: The authorities have previously limited internet access during or after protests.

phrases.quote: A simple "asante", or "thanks", will suffice in reply.
a firm "hapana", meaning "no", will do the trick.
The most polite way to refuse something is to say "sihitaji" (pronounced see-hih-tah-jee)- "I don't need it".
